description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Font, which validates the 'font' shorthand CSS property in the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for constructing the validator with configuration data and for validating font property strings.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Font
classes.description: A class that validates shorthand CSS font property values within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator by extracting relevant font property definitions from the configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given font property string against CSS rules and predefined font options.
